name: Summer Rec Camp
operator_name: City of South Portland Parks, Recreation & Waterfront
description_short: A city-run summer recreation camp for South Portland residents entering grades K-8, with field trips, performers, games, and arts and crafts. Only South Portland residents can attend, and spaces are limited.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 deposit is refundable until June 9 (the page gives no year; its financial aid dates look like they are from a past season).
